frameworks.identifier_check: Issue date and paragraph numbers 4.5, 5.3, 5.9, 5.10 and 5.23 read in the guidelines PDF on mas.gov.sg. The cited paragraphs, and the dates in 1.8, were checked against the full 30-page text on 2026-11-20.

limits: This pack is a mapping written by the vendor. It is not an assessment, a certification or a statement of conformity, and no independent assessor took part.

A single row's hash can be checked alone against the signed tree root when the bundle carries tree-checkpoint.note (verify-inclusion, with the external public key and workspace id). verify-inclusion does not recompute that hash from the row's content; only verify on the whole bundle binds content to the hash. The checkpoint has one signer: no witness cosignature is checked.
No signed scope attestation: nothing here states that a requested time range holds exactly N records, and no second party countersigns the head.
The signed head covers ledger rows from sequence 0 to the head. Removing or reordering a row inside that range fails verification. This does not show that every event that happened was recorded.
Transparency-log anchoring is per-batch and best-effort, and coverage is partial. A signed but unanchored batch root is still valid. The pack shows the count this bundle carried.
A timestamp is checked only when the examiner supplies the timestamp authority certificate. Without it the checkpoint time is the signer's own statement.
A code anchor shows where a check is implemented at this map version. It does not show that a control operated over any period.
Requirement summaries are paraphrases. Read the source text before relying on any row.

controls.requirement: A high-risk AI system technically allows events to be recorded automatically over its lifetime.
controls.evidence: ledger.ndjson rows; report fields rows and chain
controls.gap: Covers only events the gateway wrote to the action ledger. Events that never reached the ledger are invisible here.

controls.requirement: Logs capture events relevant to identifying situations that may present a risk or a substantial modification.
controls.evidence: policy_activated events and artifacts/*.json; report field actions.replayed
controls.gap: Records policy and tool-contract changes and the decisions taken under them. It does not classify any event as a risk.

controls.requirement: Logs support the provider's post-market monitoring.
controls.gap: Post-market monitoring is a provider process. The bundle is one input to it at most.

controls.requirement: Logs support monitoring of the system's operation by its deployer.
controls.gap: A bundle is a point-in-time export, not continuous monitoring.

controls.requirement: Minimum log content for remote biometric identification systems.
controls.gap: The bundle carries none of the biometric-specific fields.

controls.requirement: Providers keep automatically generated logs under their control for at least six months.
controls.gap: A bundle shows a sequence range, not how long records were kept.

controls.requirement: Risk classification and criticality assessment of each use case.
controls.gap: Risk tiering is the bank's own judgement.

controls.requirement: A person reviews and approves before a consequential action, and overrides are recorded.
controls.evidence: approval events, and the check that an approval-gated execution starts only after its approval is consumed; report field actions.denied
controls.gap: Shows approval decisions for protected tool calls. It does not show reviewer competence or that a review was meaningful.

controls.requirement: Third-party and vendor risk management.
controls.gap: Contracts and vendor oversight are outside the bundle.

controls.requirement: Operational resilience, including containment of a misbehaving agent.
controls.evidence: denied_runtime events with reason workspace_paused; report fact workspace-paused-refusals
controls.gap: Shows protected tool calls a paused workspace refused. The pause itself is not an event in the bundle, a refusal caused by a revoked or expired key is deliberately not recorded, and recovery evidence is outside the bundle.

controls.requirement: Ongoing performance monitoring for drift and behavioural change.
controls.gap: Monitoring telemetry is outside the bundle.

controls.requirement: Records of tool calls, approvals, overrides and actions allow a material event to be reconstructed, with version records for policies.
controls.evidence: ledger.ndjson, artifacts/*.json, checkpoint.json; report fields head_seq and head_hash
controls.anchor_text: covering head does not equal final row
controls.gap: Holds action-ledger events and the policy and tool-contract artifacts they reference. Retrieved sources, model version records and retention are outside the bundle.

controls.requirement: Internal audit and independent challenge.
controls.evidence: checkpoint.sig verified under a key the examiner supplies
controls.anchor_text: checkpoint does not verify under external pin
controls.gap: Lets a second party re-check the record offline. It is not an audit.

controls.requirement: AI system observability.
controls.gap: Observability telemetry is outside the bundle.

controls.requirement: Human feedback loop for AI systems.
controls.gap: The bundle carries no feedback records.

controls.requirement: Agent decisions are recorded so they can be audited and explained.
controls.evidence: decision_made events; report fields actions.replayed and actions.not_replayable
controls.gap: Replays recorded policy decisions from bundled artifacts. It does not explain model reasoning, and decisions on opaque fields are listed as not replayable.

controls.requirement: A gated action has one tamper-evident record linking the action, the policy rule, the approver, the decision and its state changes.
controls.evidence: approval and execution events checked for causal order
controls.gap: The verifier does not check how the approver was authenticated or any trace correlation identifier.

controls.requirement: Board-approved AI policy.
controls.gap: An organisational document, outside the bundle.

controls.requirement: AI system governance across the lifecycle, with human oversight before autonomous systems act on financial decisions.
controls.evidence: approval events, and the check that an approval-gated execution starts only after its approval is consumed
controls.gap: Shows recorded approvals only. Lifecycle documentation, validation and drift monitoring are outside the bundle.

controls.requirement: AI incident reporting.
controls.gap: The bundle is not an incident report.

controls.requirement: AI inventory within the regulated entity.
controls.gap: The bundle is not an inventory of models or use cases.

controls.requirement: Risk-based audit of AI inputs, models and outputs, including human override for critical decisions.
controls.evidence: manifest.json member hashes; the whole bundle re-checkable offline
controls.gap: Gives an auditor a record to check. It is not an audit framework, and data inputs and model internals are outside the bundle.

controls.requirement: Public disclosures on AI use.
controls.gap: Disclosures are the regulated entity's own.

controls.requirement: An accurate inventory of AI use cases, systems and models across the institution.
controls.gap: The bundle is not an inventory of use cases, systems or models.

controls.requirement: For high-risk use cases, contingency plans and tested kill-switch protocols where applicable.
controls.evidence: denied_runtime events with reason workspace_paused; report fact workspace-paused-refusals
controls.gap: Shows protected tool calls a paused workspace refused. It does not show that a plan exists or was tested, and the pause itself is not an event in the bundle.

controls.requirement: Controls for human oversight across the AI life cycle, with oversight activities and interventions logged.
controls.evidence: approval events, and the check that an approval-gated execution starts only after its approval is consumed; report field actions.denied
controls.gap: Shows approval decisions for protected tool calls. It does not show oversight roles, staff capability or the quality of a review.

controls.requirement: Controls on third-party AI, including testing it in the institution's own context.
controls.gap: Vendor onboarding, contracts and testing are outside the bundle.

controls.requirement: Ongoing monitoring of deployed AI with metrics, thresholds and drift checks.
controls.gap: Monitoring telemetry and drift measures are outside the bundle.

controls.requirement: Records of monitoring, incidents and remediation, and consideration of logging prompts and model responses with model versions for AI agents.
controls.evidence: ledger.ndjson, artifacts/*.json, checkpoint.json; report fields head_seq and head_hash
controls.anchor_text: covering head does not equal final row
controls.gap: Holds action-ledger events and the policy and tool-contract artifacts they reference. It does not hold prompts, model responses or model versions.
